modes.name: hunt
modes.purpose: Analyze supplied telemetry and benign alternatives

modes.name: incident
modes.purpose: Reconstruct supported suspicious or compromised activity

modes.name: verify
modes.purpose: Recheck an existing finding against its invariant

modes.name: intel
modes.purpose: Retrieve dated authoritative public intelligence and correlate supplied components
modes.input: Topic and optional CVE identifier; no filesystem target required
modes.outputs: THREAT_INTELLIGENCE.md or topic report (CVE_ANALYSIS.md, OWASP_UPDATES.md, INCIDENT_INTELLIGENCE.md), intelligence.json, source-status.json, optional PROJECT_EXPOSURE.md

mechanisms.agent: Mode cues interpreted by the selected skill; not shell commands.
mechanisms.installer: panda-suite install/update copies skill definitions; does not execute a mode.
mechanisms.helper: help/request validate a contract; intel retrieves dated public intelligence only with explicit network opt-in.
